goal: Prevent bitcoin-cli with -rpcclienttimeout=0 from failing immediately with a connection error on macOS
Avoid OS select errors and poll overflows by capping socket wait durations to about 25 days
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Reproduced the issue locally on macOS and suggested functional test coverage (fjahr)
Verified by building and testing on Windows (winterrdog)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it fixes a regression on macOS where bitcoin-cli fails immediately when disabling timeout
Resolves an OS-specific socket runtime failure affecting release candidates

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it fixes an RPC client regression breaking documented no-timeout usage
Ensures long-running RPC commands do not fail immediately on platforms using select

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it prevents socket wait failures from system limit violations or integer overflows
Protects socket wait utilities across platforms when handling large timeout durations
